field.label: Group
field.help: The client group this resolver serves. The group "default" is used for every client that has no group of its own, and must contain at least one resolver.

field.label: Address
field.help: Upstream resolver, optionally prefixed with a protocol: 1.1.1.1, tcp-tls:1.1.1.1:853, https://dns.quad9.net/dns-query or quic:dns.adguard.com.
